note: Which company makes each vehicle make, so a company-level register (SBTi, keyed by LEI) can reach a vehicle. A make is mapped only where the EPA's certifying manufacturer code for that make belongs to the LEI holder or its US arm, and the LEI was confirmed active in GLEIF. Makes with their own EPA code under a parent (Rolls-Royce under BMW, Polestar beside Volvo) are left unmapped, as are makers SBTi lists without an LEI (Kia).
